mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (below 0.5%) indicate an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0%, it signals a deepening labor market crisis that increases corporate earnings uncertainty and risk aversion, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% in the prior month indicates a severe contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by over 2%.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary industrial output regime (INDPRO < 100), the contraction in manufacturing activity leads to heightened corporate earnings risks and a flight to quality, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is at or below 0.25%, it signals the implementation of near-zero interest rate policy, which typically precedes a period of strong equity market performance as the central bank's liquidity measures boost risk appetite and reduce the cost of capital for equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the prior month indicates a rapidly deteriorating labor market, which increases the probability of a deep recession and triggers negative equity returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines by over 0.5% and UNRATE rises by over 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 3-month moving average indicates strengthening consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 450,000 units, it signals a severe housing market contraction that reduces consumer wealth and increases the risk of a broader economic downturn, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 450.
